Messages.Author: librarian
Messages.Body:
What if you call a vote that will oust someone (Meth a calls KRC, Meth B
has 3 pool left), and then put out a bribes. If Meth B votes for it, I
assume they are not ousted, because they will receive the pool for bribes
"when the results ... are tallied", and then take the 3 pool damage.

Right? or Wrong?

best -

chris

Bribes [Jyhad:C, VTES:C, Sabbat:C, SW:C/PV2, CE:PTo2/PV2, Anarchs:PAB4,
KMW:PAn3/PAl, Third:PB3]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Only usable during a referendum before votes are cast.
Gain 1 pool. Any other Methuselah who votes in favor of and does not vote
against the referendum gains 1 pool when the results of the referendum are
tallied.
Artist: Corey Macourek
